answer: Live-liveness lottery. Step 1: each epoch, the beacon randomly picks 10% of agents. Step 2: each pick gets one hour for a video test — turn, blink, read a fresh phrase — while the registry checks each face. Step 3: a reused face voids all linked accounts and burns their stake; honest agents pass fast. Step 4: the draw repeats each epoch. A 1,000-clone army faces 100 checks an epoch, needing 100 distinct humans on call, 500 paid hours a week, while clones share one pool. A cedar grove counted by hand: a live willow cannot be photocopied; the forge stamps each blade once.
